legal.title: Legal
legal.termsDescription: View terms of service and privacy policy

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using this clinic application, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement.

services.title: 2. Use of Services
services.content: This application provides medical appointment booking and health record management services. You agree to use these services only for lawful purposes and in accordance with these terms.

userAccount.title: 3. User Account
userAccount.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account and password. You agree to accept responsibility for all activities that occur under your account.

medicalInfo.title: 4. Medical Information
medicalInfo.content: All medical information provided through this application is confidential and protected under applicable privacy laws. We are committed to maintaining the privacy and security of your health information.

appointments.title: 5. Appointments
appointments.content: Appointment bookings are subject to doctor availability. Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance. No-shows may result in charges.

liability.title: 6. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: This application is a tool to facilitate medical appointments and record keeping. It does not replace professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

termination.title: 7. Termination
termination.content: We reserve the right to terminate or suspend your account at any time for violations of these terms or for any other reason deemed necessary.

changes.title: 8. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting in the application.

contact.title: 9. Contact Information
contact.content: If you have any questions about these Terms of Service, please contact us at support@clinicapp.com.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal and medical information when you use our clinic application.

dataCollection.title: 2. Information We Collect
dataCollection.content: We collect personal information such as name, contact details, medical history, and appointment data to provide our services effectively.

dataUsage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
dataUsage.content: Your information is used to schedule appointments, maintain medical records, communicate with healthcare providers, and improve our services.

dataSharing.title: 4. Information Sharing
dataSharing.content: We do not sell or rent your personal information. Medical information is only shared with authorized healthcare providers involved in your care.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your information, including encryption, secure servers, and access controls.

userRights.title: 6. Your Rights
userRights.content: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal information. You may also request a copy of your data or restrict its processing.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies and similar technologies to improve user experience, analyze usage patterns, and maintain session security.

thirdParty.title: 8. Third-Party Services
thirdParty.content: Our application may integrate with third-party services for enhanced functionality. These services have their own privacy policies.

children.title: 9. Children's Privacy
children.content: Our services are not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

changes.title: 10. Policy Changes
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of significant changes through the application or email.

contact.title: 11. Contact Us
contact.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data, please contact us at privacy@clinicapp.com.
